resetModal.title: Reset All Characteristics?
resetModal.body:
This will reset all characteristics to their default values.
Any changes you've made will be lost.

characteristics.Strength.description: Raw physical power — lifting, breaking, and striking with brute force.
characteristics.Stamina.description: Endurance and resilience — how long you can fight, march, and survive.
characteristics.Dexterity.description: Fine motor control — precision with hands, tools, and weapons.
characteristics.Quickness.description: Speed and reflexes — reacting first and moving fastest.
characteristics.Intelligence.description: Reasoning and memory — solving problems and recalling knowledge.
characteristics.Perception.description: Awareness and sharp senses — noticing what others miss.
characteristics.Presence.description: Force of personality — inspiring allies and intimidating foes.
characteristics.Communication.description: Eloquence and charm — persuading, bartering, and forging bonds.
characteristics.Strength.deity: Thor the Thunderer is the patron god of Strength.
characteristics.Stamina.deity: Tyr the One-Handed is the patron god of Stamina.
characteristics.Dexterity.deity: Ull the Bowman is the patron god of Dexterity.
characteristics.Quickness.deity: Njord the Wind-Rider is the patron god of Quickness.
characteristics.Intelligence.deity: Loki the Trickster is the patron god of Intelligence.
characteristics.Perception.deity: Heimdal the Watchman is the patron god of Perception.
characteristics.Presence.deity: Odin the Allfather is the patron god of Presence.
characteristics.Communication.deity: Freyr the Shining One is the patron god of Communication.
